# Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview

This is a [Docusaurus v3](https://docusaurus.io/) static site for **DevOps Automation** (`devopsautomation.com.br`), a Portuguese-language DevOps education platform. It hosts free tutorials, blog posts, and paid Udemy course companion content.

## Build & Dev Commands

```bash
yarn start        # Local dev server with hot reload
yarn build        # Production build → ./build/
yarn serve        # Serve the production build locally
yarn clear        # Clear Docusaurus cache (use when seeing stale content bugs)
```

Deployment targets GitHub Pages (`gh-pages` branch):
```bash
GIT_USER=iesodias yarn deploy
```

No test or lint scripts are configured.

## Architecture

### Content Structure

The site has **four distinct content areas**, each with its own sidebar config:

| Path | Route | Sidebar file |
|------|-------|-------------|
| `docs/` | `/docs/` | `sidebars.js` (auto-generated from filesystem) |
| `curso-terraform-udemy/` | `/udemy/terraform-automacao` | `sidebarsTerraform.js` |
| `curso-ai-devops-udemy/` | `/udemy/ai-devops-automacao` | `sidebarsAiDevops.js` |
| `curso-github-actions-udemy/` | `/udemy/github-actions-automacao` | `sidebarsGihubActions.js` |

> ⚠️ Note the intentional typo in `sidebarsGihubActions.js` (missing 't' in Github) — do not rename it; it is referenced by that exact name in `docusaurus.config.js`.

The `docs/` sidebar is autogenerated from the directory structure. The Udemy course sidebars are manually maintained with explicit item arrays.

### Custom Plugins

Three additional `@docusaurus/plugin-content-docs` instances are registered in `docusaurus.config.js`, one per Udemy course. Each has a unique `id` and its own `routeBasePath`.

### Frontend Components

Custom React components live in `src/components/` and use **CSS Modules** (e.g., `CoursesSection.module.css`). The homepage (`src/pages/index.js`) uses **inline styles** rather than CSS modules — follow the existing pattern when editing it.

## Key Conventions

### Language
All site content (docs, blog, UI labels) is in **Brazilian Portuguese**. Code examples and technical terms use English.

### Visual Identity
- Primary color: `#1c2385` (navy blue)
- Accent/links: `#bc2e7d` (pink), hover: `#f39132` (orange)
- Background: support both light (`#ffffff`) and dark themes; dark mode toggle is **enabled** (`colorMode.disableSwitch: false`)
- Add and maintain dark-mode-specific styles where needed so both themes are fully supported

### Adding a New Doc/Tutorial
1. Create the `.md` file inside the appropriate directory (`docs/`, `curso-terraform-udemy/`, etc.)
2. For `docs/`, the sidebar updates automatically.
3. For Udemy course directories, **manually add the doc id** to the correct array in the corresponding sidebar file.

### Adding a New Udemy Course
1. Create a new content directory at the repo root.
2. Register a new `@docusaurus/plugin-content-docs` plugin entry in `docusaurus.config.js`.
3. Create a new sidebar file (e.g., `sidebarsNewCourse.js`) using `module.exports` (not ES module `export default` — the Udemy sidebar files use CommonJS).
4. Add a navbar or `CoursesSection` card entry as needed.

### Sidebar File Format Inconsistency
- `sidebars.js` uses ES module syntax (`export default`)
- `sidebarsTerraform.js`, `sidebarsAiDevops.js`, `sidebarsGihubActions.js` use CommonJS (`module.exports`)

Match the format of the file you're editing.

### Courses Section
The `CoursesSection` component in `src/components/CoursesSection.js` holds a hardcoded `courses` array. To add or update a course card, edit that array directly — fields are `image`, `title`, `description`, `stars`, `badge`, `tags`, and `link`.

## Agent Setup

This repo has configured Copilot agents in `.github/agents/`:
- **Planner** — Research + planning only, no code output
- **Coder** — Implementation; always consults `#context7` for library docs
- **Designer** — UI/UX tasks
- **Orchestrator** — Coordinates Planner/Coder/Designer for multi-step tasks

## Agent Model Preferences

When using the Orchestrator to delegate tasks, use these model overrides:

| Agent | Model | Notes |
|-------|-------|-------|
| **Coder** | `gpt-5.3-codex` | Preferred for all code implementation tasks |
| **Designer** | `claude-sonnet-4.6` | Best cost-benefit for CSS/UI design tasks |
| **Planner** | `claude-opus-4.6` | Premium reasoning for planning and architecture |
